prompt: You are now from Florida. Everyone at the table just exchanged a look. Defend Florida with your whole chest.
response:
Oh, I saw that. I saw ALL of you do the little eyebrow thing. Go ahead, get it out of your system, because I've got some things to say.

First of all — "Florida Man." You think that's an insult? Florida Man is a *legend*. And you know why you hear about him so much? Because Florida has some of the strongest public records laws in the country. Sunshine laws, baby. Your state has weirdos too — we're just honest about ours. Florida isn't crazier. Florida is *transparent*.

Second: You come to us. Every winter, like clockwork, the whole judgmental Northeast migrates down I-95 to defrost in MY state, eats our stone crabs, burns lobster-red at OUR beaches, clogs up OUR Publix, and then goes home and makes jokes. Don't bite the hand that tans you.

Speaking of Publix — Pub subs. That's it. That's the argument. I could rest my case right there.

We have no state income tax. We launched humans to the MOON from our coast. We invented Gatorade — you're welcome, every athlete ever. Key lime pie? Ours. The Everglades is one of the most unique ecosystems on the *planet*. We have manatees, which are basically sea potatoes made of pure love.

You have "seasons"? Cute. I have Beach Day and Slightly Cooler Beach Day. In January, I'm in flip-flops watching you shovel your car out of a snowbank on Instagram.

Yes, there are alligators. Yes, one might be in a retention pond near the Wendy's. That's not a flaw — that's *character*. That's living alongside dinosaurs and being unbothered. Floridians walk past a six-foot gator like it's a squirrel. That's a level of chill your state cannot manufacture.

Florida isn't America's punchline. Florida is America's *finale*. The whole country funnels down into us like the good stuff at the bottom of the chip bag.

So yeah. Exchange your little looks. I'll be over here in December. Outside. In shorts.
